notablePrerequisites: Animar has at least two +1/+1 counters on it.
description:
Cast Sparkcaster by paying {R}{G}.
Birgi, Animar and Tangleroot trigger.
Resolve the Tangleroot and Birgi triggers, adding {R}{G}.
Resolve the Animar trigger, putting a +1/+1 counter on it.
When Sparkcaster enters the battlefield, its first and second abilities trigger.
Resolve the second Sparkcaster trigger, dealing 1 damage to any player or planeswalker.
Resolve the first Sparkcaster trigger, returning itself from the battlefield to your hand.
Repeat.

uses.name: Birgi, God of Storytelling // Harnfel, Horn of Bounty
